promptStandard: Project-authored opaque standard-material cable-link source for two collinear desk device ports. The production sample uses local endpoint faces A[-0.7,0,0] and B[0.7,0,0], a 1.4m endpoint span inside a 1.6m x 0.03m x 0.03m source envelope. The runtime link adapts only the central body to a same-height span of 0.14m..0.70m while fixed plug segments remain unchanged. Use solid positive-thickness geometry with a continuous connected path and a restrained mid-span slack loop. Keep the source static with no flexible physics, textures, light animation, or external art assets. Export identity-scale GLB in metres, Y up, +Z forward.
